name: holdout-sales-call
description: A sales call: the seller introduces a colleague, who then speaks; the buyer's side asks questions.
lines: Thanks for having us. I'm joined by my colleague Ben, who looks after implementation, so he can answer the technical questions.
Hi everyone, good to meet you.
Hi Ben. Our main worry is the migration from the old system, how long does that usually take?
For a team your size it's usually four to six weeks, most of that is cleaning up the old data.
And does that include training for the support team?
Yes, we run two training sessions as part of it.
Shall I send over the proposal after this, Siobhan?
Yes please, send it to me and I'll share it with finance.
